decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.Reason: This is required by Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

The development to which this permission relates shall be carried out in accordance with the materials specified on the approved plans and on the submitted application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development, in accordance with Policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and Policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The works shall be carried out and maintained in accordance with the deposited Reasonable Exception Statement  is compliant with Policy D12(A).Reason: In the interests of fire safety and to ensure the safety of all building users in accordance with Policy D12 (Fire Safety) of the London Plan 2021.

The garage hereby permitted shall be used only for purposes ancillary to the enjoyment of the existing dwelling house as a single family dwelling unit known as 14 Rollersby Road and shall not be occupied as an independent or self-contained dwelling unit.Reason: To prevent the undesirable establishment of a separate independent unit of living accommodation in the interests of the residential amenity of the area and to ensure compliance with Policy DM10 of the Core Strategy (2012)."

Prior to beneficial occupation of the development to which this permission relates, the recommendations contained within  paragraphs 7.3.2-7.3.5 and section 8.3 paragraphs 8.3.1 - 8.3.5 within the Preliminary Ecological Appraisal prepared by ROAVR dated 27 August 2026  shall be implemented in full and permanently retained thereafter. The applicant shall install the minimum of one integrated  bat box within  existing  dwelling to be installed away from windows and artificial light sources. In respect of external lighting within the development, this should be kept to a minimum and follow the guidance from the Bat Conservation Trust 'Bats and artificial lighting at Night ' (2023). Reason: To safeguard the biodiversity and nature conservation value of the site, in accordance with  NPPF 2026, Policy G6 of the London Plan 2021 and Policies CS3 and DM6 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.
description: Demolition of existing rear detached cement garage and erection of a single storey workshop/garage.
